subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The experiment did not prove every detail of ancient travel, but it showed what might have been possible.”?
options: It showed that human mistakes can sometimes be managed and healed, but only through long-term responsibility.
Sometimes studying history means rebuilding a tool and letting wind, water, and human skill answer part of the question.
Sometimes it means choosing which parts must remain and which parts must change so a place can live again.
They learned that helping an animal sometimes means making it leave safely, not keeping it nearby for fun.
